name: Pomán
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: An Argentine geographical indication in Catamarca province. Muscat of Alexandria and Bonarda are the most planted grapes at 26% each, followed by Malbec at 21%.
